description.narrative:
The objective of the intervention in the GUARD-Plus Project is to harness the collective power of African non-state actors to influence governments and other duty bearers in securing environmental and climate justice.
The intervention aims to address critical challenges related to climate change and sustainable development by implementing five key pathways:
1. Resilient Livelihood Systems for Communities at the Frontline of Climate Crisis Enhancing the resilience of vulnerable populations to adapt to changing environmental conditions and reduce susceptibility to climate-related risks.
2. Enhanced Capacity of Stakeholders to Engage in Implementation of Paris Agreement Instruments Strengthening knowledge and skills of key actors to foster more effective climate policies and actions.
3. Unlocking Climate Finance for Climate Action Addressing the inadequacy and inaccessibility of climate finance, and advocating for increased and simplified access to climate funds.
4. Ensuring African Peoples' Fair Share, Rights, and Dignity in the Just Transition Advocating for fair and inclusive policies that safeguard communities and promote responsible resource management.
5. Enhancing the Capacity of PACJA Organs, National Platforms, and Sector-Based Initiatives Strengthening collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and strategic partnerships to catalyze action for resilient development across Africa.
By the end of the intervention, the project aims to ensure stronger policy advocacy, enhanced stakeholder engagement, improved access to climate finance, and increased resilience for frontline communities in the face of climate change.

13.2 - Integrera klimatåtgärder i politik, strategier och planering på nationell nivå.

13.3 - Förbättra utbildningen, medvetenheten och den mänskliga och institutionella kapaciteten vad gäller begränsning av klimatförändringarna, klimatanpassning, begränsning av klimatförändringarnas konsekvenser samt tidig varning.
13.3 - Improve education, awareness-raising and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation, adaptation, impact reduction and early warning.

13.a - Fullfölja det åtagande som de utvecklade länder som är parter i Förenta nationernas ramkonvention om klimatförändringar gjort gällande en målsättning att till 2020 gemensamt mobilisera 100 miljarder US-dollar årligen från alla typer av källor för att tillgodose utvecklingsländernas behov vad gäller meningsfulla begränsningsåtgärder och insyn i genomförandet samt så snart som möjligt finansiera och operationalisera den gröna klimatfonden fullt ut.

13.a - Implement the commitment undertaken by developed-country parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change to a goal of mobilizing jointly $100 billion annually by 2020 from all sources to address the needs of developing countries in the context of meaningful mitigation actions and transparency on implementation and fully operationalize the Green Climate Fund through its capitalization as soon as possible.
